source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p9
s: Who is popularly known as 'Andhra Shivaji'?
x: Parvataneni Veeraiah Chowdary was known as 'Andhra Shivaji'. Gadicherla Harisarvottama Rao's titles were Andhra Tilak and Andhrodyama Nayakudu.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p9
s: What is another name for Motupalli?
x: Motupalli was a Kakatiya-era port where Ganapatideva issued the Abhaya Sasanam (1244) for foreign traders. The inscription calls Motupalli 'Desiyakkonda pattanam'.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p9
s: The woman who gave great service to Buddhism during the time of Ikshvaku?
x: Upasika Bodhisiri, a Buddhist lay devotee of Veerapurushadatta's reign, built a chaitya on Chuladhamma Giri at Sriparvatam. She sent Buddhist monks to Sri Lanka, Tibet and Kashmir to spread Buddhism.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p9
s: Who was the first president of Andhra Socialist Party?
x: The Andhra Socialist Party was formed at Vijayawada in June 1934 with N.G. Ranga as first president. Madduri Annapurnaiah was its first secretary.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p9
s: Which port town was famous for the handloom trade in the 16th and 17th centuries A.D.?
x: Machilipatnam was famous for calico and Kalamkari cloths, in great demand in England during the Qutb Shahi period.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p9
s: Who built the lake Kesari Samudra?
x: Kakatiya Prolaraja-I built the Arikesari/Kesari Samudram tank. Tank construction was considered one of the Sapta Santanas.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p9
s: Bhava Viveka served as Acharya in which of the following Buddhist Viharas?
x: Hiuen Tsang mentions that Bhavaviveka, founder of the Svatantrika Madhyamika school, lived in the Dhanyakataka vihara.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p9
s: In which text of the Kakatiyas can we find the legal principle that 'a woman's property inherits perfectly to her daughters and to her daughter's daughter'?
x: Ketana's Vijnaneswariyam, the first Dharmashastra work in Telugu (a translation of the Yajnavalkya Dharmashastra), states this principle.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p9
s: After which movement Tanguturi Prakasam was called Andhra Kesari?
x: During the Simon Go Back protest in Madras (1928), Prakasam bared his chest to the police saying 'Shoot me if you dare', earning the title Andhra Kesari.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p9
s: The main profession of Jayapa who wrote Nritta Ratnavali?
x: Jayapa Senani, author of Nritta Ratnavali, Gita Ratnavali and Vadya Ratnavali, was the Gajasahini (elephant corps commander) of Ganapatideva.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p9
s: Which Buddhist text mentions Andhra path?
x: Bhimasena Jataka mentions Andhrapatha. Serivanija Jataka mentions Andhranagari on the Telivaha river.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p9
s: Who was the last Ikshvaku ruler?
x: According to the Manchikallu inscription, Pallava Simhavarma invaded Vijayapuri, defeated Rudrapurushadatta and ended the Ikshvaku dynasty.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p9
s: A musical instrument called 'Jalakaranda' is mentioned in this inscription?
x: The Kakatiya-period Dharmasagara inscription mentions the musical instrument Jalakaranda.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p9
s: In which year Widow Remarriage Act was passed?
x: Lord Dalhousie's government passed the Widow Remarriage Act in 1856, largely due to Ishwarchandra Vidyasagar's efforts.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p9
s: Pedaganjam and Chinaganjam areas are famous for their produce?
x: Pedaganjam and Chinaganjam in present Prakasam district are famous for salt pans.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p9
s: Whose help did Vijayaramaraju take in Bobbili war?
x: Vijayarama Raju besieged Bobbili in 1757 with the help of the French commander Bussy. Bobbili's zamindar Ranga Rao was killed and later avenged by Tandra Paparayudu.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p10
s: Which of the following Satavahana Queen ruled as guardian of the kingdom due to her son being young?
x: After Satakarni-I died young, his queen Naganika ruled on behalf of her minor son Vedasiri. She issued the Nanaghat inscription.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p10
s: Who among the following bears the title 'Abhinavadandi'?
x: Ketana was given the title Abhinava Dandi by Tikkana. He wrote Dasakumara Charitra, Andhra Bhasha Bhushanam and Vijnaneswariyam.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p10
s: Who praised Veeresalingam as South India's Ishwara Chandra Vidya Sagar?
x: M.G. Ranade called Veeresalingam 'Dakshina Bharata Vidyasagar' at a social reform meeting in Madras in 1898.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p10
s: The "Maiputa" used by the dancers during the time of the Satavahanas was said to be?
x: Satavahana-era dancers used a foundation cream (maiputa) called Aradalam, as seen from Amaravati sculptures and Gathasaptasati.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p10
s: Main Kshetra of Goddess Vasavi?
x: Penugonda (West Godavari) is the main seat of Goddess Vasavi Kanyaka, tutelary deity of the Komatis.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p10
s: Who described Sri Parvataswamy as Buddha?
x: N. Venkataramanayya identified Sri Parvata Swami with Buddha. Karthikeya Sharma identified him with Karthikeya and Kielhorn with Mallikarjuna.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p10
s: Which Chalukya king is said to have built 108 Shaivalayas?
x: Vijayaditya-II fought 108 battles in a 12-year succession war with his brother Bhima Salki and built 108 Narendra Mrigeswara temples as atonement.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p10
s: Kakatiya Pratapa Rudra was held captive by whom at the end of his life?
x: In 1323 Ulugh Khan's forces defeated Prataparudra-II and took him captive towards Delhi. He is said to have drowned himself in the Narmada (Somodbhava) on the way.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p10
s: On whose plea did Swami Sitaram end his hunger strike?
x: Swami Sitaram (Gollapudi Sitarama Sastri) fasted at Guntur from 15 August 1951 for an Andhra state. On Nehru's suggestion Vinoba Bhave persuaded him to end it after 35 days.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p10
s: What was the rate of interest during Satavahana period on the money deposited in a bank run by shrenis?
x: The Nasik inscription of Rishabhadatta records a deposit with the Kolika guild of Govardhana at 12% interest (1 karshapana per 100 per month).

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p10
s: Which temple is famous for its beautifully designed pictorial inscriptions in the Vijayanagara style?
x: The Veerabhadra temple at Lepakshi, built by Virupanna under Achyutaraya, is famous for its Vijayanagara-period paintings depicting Ramayana and Mahabharata scenes.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p10
s: With whom is the shreni of 'Chitrameli' formed?
x: Chitrameli was an agriculturists' guild of the Kakatiya period, attested by three stone slabs found in Anantapur district.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p10
s: Which literary text gives information about sea trade during the rule of Reddy kings?
x: Srinatha's Haravilasam, dedicated to Avachi Tippayya Setti, describes foreign trade with places like Jaffna, Sinhala, Sumatra and Malaya.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p10
s: Which of the following centers has been identified by archaeologists as a center for micro stone tools?
x: Microlithic (Mesolithic) tools have been found at Giddalur, Nagarjunasagar and Kondapur.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p10
s: During the Kakatiya period, the caste groups were called as?
x: During the Kakatiya period caste associations were called Samayam, each with its own Samayacharam. Offenders were fined Samayadandana.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p10
s: The Six Points Formula came into force through this constitutional amendment?
x: The 32nd Amendment (in force 1 July 1974) inserted Articles 371D and 371E to implement the Six Point Formula for Andhra Pradesh.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p10
s: Which inscription of Pulakesi-II mentions Mangalagiri as Mangalapura?
x: The Martur inscription of Pulakesi-II (Prakasam district) records his conquest of coastal Andhra and refers to Mangalagiri as Mangalapura.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p11
s: The music science scripture "Sangeeta Chintamani" written by?
x: Pedakomati Vemareddy wrote Sangeeta Chintamani, Sahitya Chintamani and Srungara Deepika. His titles included Sarvagna Chakravarti.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p11
s: During the period of Chalukyas who received title "Gandharva Vidya Visharada"?
x: The Attili inscription says Chellavva, expert in all Gandharva vidyas, was appointed court singer by Chalukya Bhima-I. Mallappa was her father.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p11
s: During Satavahanas period "Kolica Shreni" belongs to whom?
x: The Kolika shreni was the weavers' guild. Farmers formed the Halaka, oil traders the Tilapishaka and carpenters the Vadhika shreni.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p11
s: Identify the wrong pairing?
o: Andhra Sahitya Parishad Magazine : Jayanti Ramaiah Pantulu
x: Andhra Prakasika, the first Telugu political paper, was founded by A.P. Parthasaradhi Naidu in 1885, not P. Anandacharya.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p11
s: The Chalukya King who developed Kandukuru as Bejavada?
x: Pandaranga, commander of Gunaga Vijayaditya-III, conquered Nellore and Pulicat and developed Kandukuru into a town like Bejawada.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p11
s: In ancient medieval times Pradvivaka was the advisor to the king in this department?
x: Under the Eastern Chalukyas, Pradvivakas were judicial officers who settled disputes along with tribunals of caste elders.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p11
s: During which movement was the song 'Veeragandhamu techhinaramu - Veerulevvaro Telpudi........' composed?
x: Tripuraneni Ramaswamy Chowdary sang this song to welcome the Salt Satyagrahis at Tenali.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p11
s: The first police station attacked by Alluri Sitaramaraju?
x: Alluri Sitarama Raju first attacked the Chintapalli police station on 22 August 1922 to seize arms.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p11
s: Who was the 17th century French trader who visited the mines of Andhra in search of fine gems and diamonds?
x: French merchant Tavernier described the diamond mines of the Qutb Shahi kingdom, including Kollur where the Kohinoor was found.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p11
s: Jain philosophical treatise 'Samayasara' was authored by?
x: Kondakundacharya wrote Samayasara, Pravachanasara, Niyamasara and Panchastikayasara.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p11
s: Who was the President of Andhra Mahasabha between 1941-1946?
x: Sir Vijayananda Gajapati (Sir Vijaya) of Vizianagaram presided over the Andhra Mahasabha in this period and tried to turn it into a political party.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p11
s: Who is the author of the exiled play "Viplava Parivarthanam" which was published and banned during the Non-Cooperation Movement?
x: Kodali Anjaneyulu wrote the political drama Viplava Parivartanam, whose performance was banned by the government.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p11
s: Which social reformer was the main factor behind the elimination of 'Bhogam' caste from Andhra society?
x: Raghupathi Venkataratnam Naidu (Brahmarshi) campaigned against the nautch (Bhogam) system and spread Brahmo Samaj principles in Andhra.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p11
s: Which doctrine that gave birth to Kapalikas?
x: Shaivism had Pasupata, Kalamukha and Kapalika sects. The Kapalikas worshipped Bhairava, with their main centre at Bhairavakona.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p11
s: According to art critics, the gopurams of which temple in Andhra are more beautiful than the Vithalalaya gopurams of Hampi?
x: Critics consider the gopurams of the Ramalingeswara temple at Tadipatri more beautiful than those of the Vithala temple at Hampi.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p12
s: The first criminal case was registered during the Vande Mataram movement in Andhra?
x: The Kakinada riot (31 May 1907), after Captain Kemp had a boy beaten for shouting Vande Mataram, was the first criminal case of the movement in Andhra.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p12
s: Who is the member from Andhra joined the Forward Bloc formed by Subhash Chandra Bose?
x: Madduri Annapurnaiah was the first Andhra person to join the Forward Bloc and became president of its Andhra branch in 1939.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p12
s: Who was the Andhra official who helped Sir Arthur Cotton in the construction of Godavari dam?
x: Veenam Veeranna assisted Arthur Cotton in building the Dowleswaram anicut (1847-52) and was honoured with the title Rao Bahadur.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p12
s: Who wrote the text of mathematics in Telugu called "Ganitha Sarasangraha"?
x: Pavuluri Mallana translated Mahaviracharya's Sanskrit Ganita Sarasangraha into Telugu and was rewarded by Rajaraja Narendra with the agrahara Navakhandavada.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p12
s: When did Potti Sriramulu become Amarajeevi?
x: Potti Sriramulu began his fast on 19 October 1952 in Madras and died on 15 December 1952 after 58 days.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p12
s: Dr. Y. S. Rajasekhar Reddy lost his life in the tragic incident of helicopter accident?
x: YSR died in a helicopter crash at Pavuralagutta, Kurnool district, on 2 September 2009 while going to the Rachabanda programme.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p12
s: Krishna Deva Raya's 'Jambavati Kalyanam' drama was written in which language?
x: Krishnadevaraya wrote Jambavati Kalyanam in Sanskrit; his Telugu work is Amuktamalyada.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p12
s: According to the Bhattiprolu inscription who was the ruler in the 3rd century BC?
x: The Bhattiprolu stupa inscription names Kubhiraka, son of Savera, as ruler at the end of the 3rd century BC, governing with a Nigama Sabha and Goshtis.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p12
s: Which inscription contains the 12 Sutras to be followed during the construction of Tataka?
x: The Porumamilla inscription (1369) of Vijayanagara prince Bhaskara Bhavadura describes the 12 principles for tank construction.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p12
s: Who among the following is not a member of the pact of The Gentlemen's agreement?
x: The Gentlemen's Agreement (20 February 1956) was signed by 4 Andhra leaders (Bezawada Gopala Reddy, N. Sanjeeva Reddy, Gouthu Latchanna, Alluri Satyanarayana Raju) and 4 Telangana leaders; Prakasam was not among them.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p12
s: Who wrote the 'Kurnool Circular'?
x: Kala Venkata Rao, APCC secretary, drafted the circular on Quit India programmes at Machilipatnam (29 July 1942); it was named after being found in the Kurnool Congress office.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p12
s: Who said that "Bharata Khandambu Chakkani Padi aavu Hinduvulu legaddodalai edchuchunda, Tellavaranu gadusari gollavaru pithukuchunnaaru moothulu bigiyagatti"?
x: Chilakamarthi Lakshminarasimham recited this verse after Bipin Chandra Pal's lecture at Rajahmundry in April 1907.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p12
s: Who was Vipravinodula during Vijayanagara period?
o: They are a caste of Shudras who depend only on Brahmins for their sustenance
Shudras performing their arts to entertain Brahmins
Brahmin jugglers who entertain only Brahmins in their homes
Brahmin scholars skilled in all arts
x: Vipravinodis were a sect of Brahmins who performed juggling acts, entertaining only Brahmins in their homes.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p12
s: Who led the liberation movement after the fall of the Kakatiyas?
x: According to Anitalli's Kaluvacheru grant, 75 Andhra chiefs united under Musunuri Prolaya Nayaka to resist the Delhi Sultanate.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p13
s: During the rule of the Sri Krishnadeva Raya the 'Kandacharya' department looked into these matters?
x: Per Rayavachakamu, Kandachara was the military department of the Vijayanagara administration; Attavana was revenue and Dharmasana judicial.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p13
s: Who told us that Vijayanagara empire had more than 300 port towns?
x: Persian ambassador Abdur Razzak, visiting during Devaraya-II's reign, recorded that Vijayanagara had 300 port towns.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p13
s: The most popular and beloved festival during the administration of Reddy kings?
x: Vasantotsavam was the most popular festival under the Reddy kings; Kumaragiri Reddy earned the title Karpura Vasantarayalu for celebrating it.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p13
s: Krishnadevaraya's Bhuvana Vijaya Bhavan was described in detail by whom?
x: Portuguese traveller Domingo Paes described Bhuvana Vijayam, Krishnadevaraya's assembly hall where the Ashtadiggajas sat.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p13
s: Which of the following spiritual doctrine propagated by Kumarila Bhattu?
x: Kumarila Bhatta propagated Purva Mimamsa, attempting to harmonise Karma Marga and Bhakti Marga.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p13
s: Volunteer force played by Duggirala Gopalakrishna was called as?
x: During the Chirala-Perala movement (1921) under Duggirala Gopalakrishnayya, the Ramadandu volunteers built huts and wells at the new settlement Ramnagar.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p13
s: In which year did Pingali Venkaiah design the tricolor design which was adopted as the national flag of India with minor modifications?
x: Pingali Venkaiah presented his flag design to Gandhiji at the AICC meeting in Vijayawada on 31 March-1 April 1921.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p13
s: Who was the chief minister during the separate Telangana movement in 1969?
x: Kasu Brahmananda Reddy was Chief Minister during the 1969 Telangana agitation; he resigned in September 1971.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p13
s: The Tank built by Surambika, the wife of Peda Komati Vemu?
x: The Santanasagaram inscription says Surambika, wife of Pedakomati Vemareddy, excavated the Santanasagaram tank near Phirangipuram in Guntur district.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p13
s: The early Chalukyas worshiped this mother goddess?
x: The Chalukyas claimed to be Haritiputras, and Hariti at Vijayapuri was their worshipped deity.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p13
s: What was the main factor that led to the Jai Andhra movement?
o: Supreme Court Judgment on Mulki Rules
Imposition of high taxes on Andhras
Problems in water supply between Andhra and Telangana regions
Giving less priority to Andhras in administration
x: The Supreme Court's 3 October 1972 verdict upholding the Mulki Rules triggered the Jai Andhra movement among Andhra employees and people.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p13
s: Who authored the medical treatise "Kalyanakaraka"?
x: Ugradityacharya, a resident of Ramatirtham, wrote the medical treatise Kalyanakaraka.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p1) p13
s: In which district the Manganese industry maintained the first position in the world between 1892-1929 in the production of Manganese?
x: Visakhapatnam district ranked first in the world in manganese production between 1892 and 1929.
